Maria CS: Hey team — Redwood Enablement week for Helix Therapeutics is next Thu–Fri. We need to lock office hours, a migration workshop, and two hands-on lab slots. Timezones to cover: PST / EST / CET. Who can take which shifts?

Jon P: I can take the migration workshop on Thu 10:00 PT (13:00 ET).

Lee H: I can cover Friday morning labs, roughly 08:00–11:00 PT. Happy to split into two blocks.

Tara S: Prefer two 90‑min lab blocks (intro + deep dive). Also suggest a 15‑min pre-read + live demo. Draft agenda below.

Tara S: ```
Thu migration workshop (90m):
 - 10:00 intro + goals (10m)
 - 10:10 migration walkthrough (45m)
 - 10:55 live debugging / Q&A (25m)
 - 11:20 wrap + follow-ups (5m)

Fri labs (2x90m):
 - Lab A 08:00 PT: onboarding + prefix caching exercise
 - Lab B 10:00 PT: dedicated capacity + failover test
```

devex-bot: Draft calendar created: https://cal.redwood.dev/helix-enable-draft — invites not sent.

Maria CS: Thanks. @Lee H can you confirm if the labs include a quick pre-assessment capture? We want to flag renewal risk signals and note blockers.

Lee H: Yes — I'll add a 5‑question pre-assessment (Google form) and a 3‑question post lab pulse. I'll also attach the migration checklist doc during Lab B.

Jon P: Customer asked for a short Dedicated demo showing  p95 latency. Can infra reserve a 1‑GPU canary for Fri 09:00 PT? @Kai (Infra)

Kai (Infra): I can provision a 1‑GPU slot for Fri 09:00–10:30 PT. Will mark as "Canary demo — Helix" and share access.

Tara S: For feedback capture I'm going to run an NPS micro‑pulse right after each session (single question + optional comment). I'll attach the form to the invite.

Maria CS: :thumbsup: Action items — Maria will finalize invites tomorrow; Lee owns lab materials & assessment; Jon owns migration workshop content; Tara owns feedback forms; Kai reserves infra.

Jon P: Quick swap question — I prefer the 09:00 Friday slot if someone wants 10:00 instead.

Lee H: I can swap blocks with Jon. I can take 10:00, Jon can have 09:00.

Maria CS: Great. I'll update the calendar and add a prep checklist for the customer (deploy steps, sample prompts, rollback plan). Also recording will be turned on; devex-bot, please create recording link post-session.

devex-bot: Recording hook enabled; meeting notes template attached to calendar event.

Maria CS: Thanks all — closing thread. Final invites by tomorrow COB. If any blockers, ping me here. :pray:
